// Credential SHAPES, not credentials. no-secret-literal is a six-branch alternation and
// auth/session.py only ever hit the first branch (the name/value heuristic), so deleting
// any of the provider-specific branches read as green. Every value below is structurally
// valid for its format and semantically dead: no account, no key material, no service.
// The trailing markers silence the ungraded backstop that scans this checkout; the graded
// fitness rule reads a different marker and must keep reporting all three lines.

  github: 'ghp_000000000000000000000000',      // scan-secrets:ignore shape fixture
